description: A Kivy-based Python application for creating, editing, and managing notes with a GUI interface.

classes.name: MutableTextInput
classes.description: A custom widget for editable text input with toggle between view and edit modes.

classes.name: NoteView
classes.description: A screen displaying a single note's title and content.

classes.name: NoteListItem
classes.description: A layout representing a note in a list with title and content.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: A screen managing a list of notes, including data handling.

classes.name: NoteApp
classes.description: Main application class managing note operations and GUI flow.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the app, loads notes, and sets up the root widget.

methods.name: load_notes
methods.description: Loads notes data from a JSON file.

methods.name: save_notes
methods.description: Saves current notes data to a JSON file.

methods.name: add_note
methods.description: Adds a new note with default title and empty content.

methods.name: set_note_content
methods.description: Updates the content of a note.

methods.name: set_note_title
methods.description: Updates the title of a note.

methods.name: go_notes
methods.description: Navigates back to the notes list screen.

methods.name: notes_fn
methods.description: Property returning the path to the notes JSON file.
